Name: Distant Bonds - Remote Conversations and Gifts
Author: UriHacchi
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#C4A1FF]DISTANT BONDS[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Remote Conversations and Gifts[/size]
[i]By UriHacchi[/i]

Keep your friendships close, wherever your day takes you.
[b]English • Español • Português (Brasil) • Français • 简体中文[/b][/center]

Open the [b]Social menu[/b] to talk to villagers you have already met or send a gift from your backpack. Familiar Stardew styling, purple accents and short tooltips keep everything easy to find.

[b]Chat. Choose a gift. Return to the same Social menu.[/b]
Your place in the list is preserved after the conversation or gift response finishes.

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]New in 0.4.18[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Simplified Chinese:[/b] all interface text and settings now follow the game's Chinese language option. Thanks to Herdore for the translation suggestion![/*]
[*][b]Clearer text:[/b] the game's localized font, a softer shadow and more room for headings and control hints.[/*]
[*][b]Spouse controls:[/b] familiar gift and conversation icons with daily checks, including additional spouses from Polyamory Sweet. A gift already given stays visible but dimmed.[/*]
[*][b]Smoother conversations:[/b] improved return to Social after answers and better handling of location questions that should not keep restarting.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Start here[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open [b]Social[/b] and find a villager you know.[/*]
[*]Use the [b]conversation control[/b] to talk, or the [b]gift icon[/b] to open your backpack. Hover for a short explanation.[/*]
[*]Choose an item and press [b]Give[/b] to send one unit. You can cancel before confirming.[/*]
[/list]The gift selector shows your unlocked backpack space, adapts to smaller windows and marks the chosen item in purple. Optional birthday and weekly gift indicators help you keep track without revealing gift tastes.

[b]More to talk about[/b]
After the daily chat, you can read other conversations currently available to the NPC: pending lines, activities, locations, recent topics, prepared spouse or roommate dialogue, and festival dialogue during free interaction. The daily 20-point friendship reward is granted only once. Story requirements still apply.

[b]Icon guide and controls[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Conversation icons[/b]
[list]
[*]Speech bubble: daily conversation.[/*]
[*]Next: more dialogue is waiting.[/*]
[*]Repeat arrows: a line can be heard again while available.[/*]
[*]Heart: prepared spouse or roommate dialogue.[/*]
[*]Exclamation mark: an active conversation topic.[/*]
[*]Festival pennant: available dialogue at the current festival.[/*]
[*]Check: today's chat is done and no additional dialogue was found.[/*]
[*]X: nothing was available when you tried. The control becomes available again when dialogue is found.[/*]
[/list][b]Gift selector controls[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouse: click an item, then Give. Right click or Escape closes the selector.[/*]
[*]Wheel: move between inventory slots, stopping at either end.[/*]
[*]Middle click: choose the focused item; click again to confirm without moving the pointer. Scrolling or changing controls resets that confirmation.[/*]
[*]Keyboard: WASD/arrows to navigate; Enter/Space to activate.[/*]
[*]Controller: D-pad/left stick to navigate; A to activate, B to cancel.[/*]
[/list]On married rows, you can click the gift or conversation icon or its daily checkbox. Purple conversation indicators remain available after the daily chat.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Install or update[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer.[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Close the game and download the [b]full 0.4.18 package[/b] from Files.[/*]
[*]Extract [b][SMAPI] Distant Bonds[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI. The interface uses your game language automatically.[/*]
[/list][b]Updating?[/b] Back up your config.json, replace the previous mod folder, then restore that file to keep your settings. Keep only one installed copy. If you still use the old [SMAPI] Conversacion a distancia folder, move it outside Mods first.

Settings are optional: use Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json to adjust conversations, gifts, confirmations and interface preferences.

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Optional compatibility & special thanks[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] — [b]ApryllForever[/b]. Distant Bonds shows daily gift and conversation controls for additional spouses recognized by the Social menu. Tested with Polyamory Sweet 1.6.1 in the author's single-player setup. Thank you for giving players more ways to build their Stardew families![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] — [b]spacechase0 and bcmpinc[/b]. The gift selector supports the unlocked 48-slot backpack.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51620]Even Bigger Backpack[/url] — [b]witchtopia[/b]. The selector also supports the unlocked 60-slot backpack.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43127]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative[/url] — [b]dazuki, Abs0rbed, tqdv and Annosz[/b]. Its extra menu tab is temporarily hidden while the gift selector is open. Integration is also included for UI Info Suite 2.[/*]
[/list]Thank you to these creators for making everyday life in the valley more enjoyable. [b]These mods are optional; no separate compatibility patch is needed.[/b] Follow each mod's own requirements.

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Good to know[/color][/b][/size]
Gifts keep the game's tastes, quality effects, birthday bonuses, reactions and limits. Some special interaction items must be delivered in person; unavailable items explain why. Distant Bonds reads available dialogue and does not replay scripted event scenes.

Tested in single-player. [b]Multiplayer and split-screen are not yet verified.[/b]

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Feedback, translations & credits[/color][/b][/size]
Found a problem? Use the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with your full SMAPI log, game/mod versions, NPC or item, and steps to reproduce it. For display issues, include a screenshot, resolution and UI scale. Translation suggestions are welcome in the comments; please mention the language and wording.

[b]Created by UriHacchi.[/b]
[b]Community contributions:[/b] Herdore for the Simplified Chinese suggestion, AnotherPillow for the native frame idea, thoreau11 and Ayoie for feedback on returning to Social, and everyone sharing reports and suggestions.

Thanks to [b]ConcernedApe[/b], the [b]SMAPI maintainers[/b] and the modding community.

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]Guía rápida en español[/color][/b][/size]
Conversa y envía regalos a los NPC conocidos desde el menú Social. Elige un objeto y pulsa [b]Regalar[/b]; al terminar la respuesta vuelves al mismo menú. La rueda recorre el inventario y dos clics de rueda permiten elegir y confirmar sin mover el cursor.

[b]La 0.4.18 añade chino simplificado, mejora la lectura y completa los controles diarios para parejas casadas, incluidas las adicionales de Polyamory Sweet.[/b] También mejora el regreso a Social y evita que ciertas preguntas de ubicación se reinicien durante el mismo día cargado.

Incluye español y cuatro idiomas más, seleccionados automáticamente. Respeta la amistad diaria y las reglas de regalos; las conversaciones adicionales no repiten los 20 puntos diarios. Generic Mod Config Menu y las compatibilidades de arriba son opcionales.

Para actualizar, cierra el juego, conserva config.json y reemplaza la carpeta del mod. Mantén una sola copia instalada. Cooperativo y pantalla dividida siguen pendientes de verificación.

Gracias a [b]ApryllForever[/b] por [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url], a [b]Herdore[/b] por la propuesta china y a todas las personas que ayudan a mejorar Distant Bonds.

[size=4][b][color=#C4A1FF]简体中文[/color][/b][/size]
在社交界面中与认识的居民交谈，或从背包中选择礼物。0.4.18 已内置简体中文，随游戏语言自动切换，无需另装汉化包。感谢 Herdore 提供翻译建议！安装和操作说明请查看下载包内的 README_ZH.md。
